# Jacobs  Private  Equity
Jacobs began his career in 1979 at age 23 with his first start-up, **Amerex Oil Associates**.

In 1989, Jacobs founded **United Waste Systems**.

In 1997, Jacobs founded **United Rentals** and grew the company into the world's largest construction equipment rental provider within 13 months.

# Letter #71: Brad Jacobs (2011)
## Letter
I co-founded my first company in 1979. It was called Amerex Oil Associates.

In 1983, we sold Amerex and I moved to London, where I started an international oil trading company called Hamilton Resources.

One month later I co-founded United Rentals.

Then I discovered C.H.
